title: Answer to inspect and abandon
description: The body of the 200 answer to an inspect or an abandon, and of the 409 answer to an abandon, which adds a code.

run.description: The run holding the workflow ID, or null.

claimed.description: Whether the run ID the message named is in the ledger. Null for an inspect without a run ID, and when the store could not be read.

snapshotRead.description: False when the store could not be read; run and claimed then mean nothing.

code.description: Only in a 409 answer to an abandon: a RefusalReason value, or abandon_refused.
